greek: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production game icon ATLAS for eight Greek magic abilities in Pantheon Realms. STYLE REFERENCES: the attached existing Apollo arrow and scarab icons are style references only. Match their richly painted old fantasy strategy game inventory art: sculptural gold, bright enamel, deep dark outlines, tiny realistic highlights and textured shaded materials. NOT flat vector, not geometric sigils, not modern UI. Transparent background. No boxes, no captions, no letters. Layout EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells in a landscape image, each object fully centered within its cell with 12% clear margin, no overlap. Row 1 left to right: (1) Aegis Shard: broken golden Greek round shield ejecting jagged metallic fragments; (2) Olympian Spark: tiny storm cloud with three branching gold-white thunderbolts; (3) Trident Surge: bronze trident wrapped by a sculptural turquoise wave; (4) Gorgon Gaze: carved green stone gorgon head with coiled snakes and glowing eyes. Row 2: (5) Titan Javelin: massive bronze spear descending through dust and shattered marble; (6) Olympian Tempest: dense swirling storm cloud with branching lightning; (7) Judgment of Olympus: enormous gold divine fist wielding thunderbolt above broken column; (8) Sea Kings Wrath: sea-horse shaped curling tidal wave with pearl foam and coral crown. The eight silhouettes must be very distinct. Match existing art quality and legibility at 64px.
